title: Liu2020 – BETA SSVEP benchmark dataset
description: The BETA SSVEP benchmark dataset comprises 64-channel EEG recordings from 70 healthy subjects performing a 40-target cued-spelling brain-computer interface task using steady-state visual evoked potentials (SSVEP). Recorded in a naturalistic classroom environment with joint frequency and phase modulation stimuli, this dataset provides a realistic benchmark for SSVEP-BCI applications with frequencies ranging from 8.0 to 15.8 Hz and 4 trials per target per subject.
methods_description: EEG data were acquired using a Synamps2 amplifier (Neuroscan) with 64 channels in the international 10-10 system, referenced to Cz, and sampled at 1000 Hz then downsampled to 250 Hz. Stimulation duration was 2 seconds for experienced subjects (S1-S15) and 3 seconds for naive subjects (S16-S70), with a 0.5-second visual cue. Subjects completed 4 blocks of 40 trials each using a 5×8 QWERTY virtual keyboard with JFPM visual flicker stimuli.
